data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for chat speech bubbles similar to WhatsApp.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable speech bubble widget with nips, shadows, borders, and margins designed for chat interfaces.
use_when: Building a chat or messaging interface in Flutter
Displaying text or content inside stylized speech bubbles
avoid_when: You need complex non-chat UI layouts unrelated to speech bubbles
You require network or state management utilities
strengths: Highly customizable nips, radius, colors, and shadows
Easy to integrate with standard Flutter text and widgets
Supports multiple nip positions and alignments
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific widget purpose (speech bubbles)
Deprecated IssueClipper will be removed in the next major version
